method.movement_control: real keyboard Arrow key events; bee position observed from rendered canvas by color-component detection; no direct mutation of module state
method.completion_rule: all three fixed prototype patches completed in each mode
method.touch_check: Playwright BrowserContext with has_touch=true/is_mobile=true; layout/control visibility and bounding boxes measured
limitations: The scripted pilot is not a human comfort playtest.
Completion time includes navigation from the fixed start position and controller correction overhead, so small timing differences should not be overinterpreted.

The local environment blocks Chromium navigation to localhost/file URLs; the exact prototype source was reconstructed into one equivalent inline HTML document with unchanged interaction code for browser execution.

intrinsic_progress_rules.auto: 0.34 progress/second while inside; standing still continues
intrinsic_progress_rules.hold: 0.52 progress/second while inside and interaction is held
intrinsic_progress_rules.sweep: movement distance / 245 while inside; standing still gives zero

capture_hashes.note: Rendered PNGs were inspected during the run. P0 exact-build artifact retention does not exist yet, so hashes document local-run provenance but are not claimed as CI-retained evidence.
